paper_title: EEGNet: A Compact Convolutional Network for EEG-based Brain-Computer Interfaces
paper_abstract: EEGNet is a compact convolutional network for EEG-based brain-computer interfaces. It uses depthwise and separable convolutions to represent EEG feature extraction concepts. The study compares it with reference approaches across P300, error-related negativity, movement-related cortical potentials, and sensory motor rhythms. With limited training data, it generalizes across paradigms better than the reference algorithms. The authors also visualize learned features to investigate their interpretation. This is a paraphrase of the arXiv abstract, not the full paper or a verbatim abstract.
